English: Students Bench
A makeshift circle of rugs and benches where young minds gather to hear the basics of faith and learning in the open steppe.
Reading Room
A simple tented enclosure where elders and youth read aloud and discuss the teachings of Islam, fostering unity and knowledge.
Teachers Pavilion
A large nomad tent reserved for respected instructors, providing structure for daily lessons and guidance for the clans children.
Scribes Nook
A mobile enclosure where literate clan members copy, comment, and preserve sacred and scholarly texts for the tribes use.
Learning Hall
A semi-permanent tent city for lectures and debate, bringing together scholars, jurists, and the devout for advanced study and legal discussion.
Scriptorium
A dedicated structure for copying Qur’ans and scholarly treatises, attracting learned travelers and cementing the clans reputation for piety.
Scholars Chamber
A large, well-appointed yurt reserved for renowned scholars and visiting theologians, fostering advanced jurisprudential and spiritual thought among the clan.
Study Room
A permanent structure with shelves of books and tablets, where elite students and future leaders receive rigorous education and spiritual guidance.
Lecture Hall
A grand assembly tent capable of hosting visiting jurists, poets, and theologians, becoming a center for learning, law, and unity across the steppe.
Muslim Madrasa
A prestigious, permanent center of learning, attracting scholars, jurists, and students from across the Muslim world, and elevating the clans religious authority and unity.
